comments.author: @yubtubtime
comments.text: I do not like Sam Altman, but it's clear why he is where he is. He's a dangerous person who will probably only continue to accumulate more power due to his uncanny sobriety and lack of defensiveness in a time when the culture's drunk on clapbacks and dunking on each other. Sam Altman only has to consistently reaffirm the same points over and over, almost like a member of the Federal Reserve, which gives him an increasingly rare aura of ethos and gravitas when combined with his technical position. Of course, it all seems like a shallow, and even psychopathic, facade, but it still works because so much of the leadership elsewhere in the world appears so clownish. Sam Altman is like Mark Zuckerberg without the pitiful desperation to be likable. Altman embraces his stony unlikability in a way that would almost be admirable if he weren't a literal super-villain in the making.
